_about: Settings for refresh_live.py. drought_areas: each growing region in items.json -> the U.S. Drought Monitor area that stands for it ([level, code]). news_searches: broad GDELT searches; each lists the foods it covers, so if a search fails exactly those foods show news as unavailable. GDELT rejects one-word phrases in quotes.

drought_area_notes.Sacramento Valley, CA: Colusa County, center of CA rice

news_searches.query: (beef OR pork OR chicken OR bacon OR ham) (shortage OR prices OR recall OR outbreak)
(egg OR eggs) (shortage OR prices OR "bird flu")
(milk OR butter OR cheese OR dairy) (shortage OR prices OR supply)
(lettuce OR tomatoes OR strawberries OR potatoes OR bananas OR oranges OR lemons) (shortage OR prices OR crop)
(wheat OR flour OR rice OR pasta OR bread) (shortage OR prices OR harvest)
(coffee OR sugar OR "dry beans" OR "canned corn" OR "peanut butter") (shortage OR prices OR harvest)
("cooking oil" OR "vegetable oil" OR "palm oil" OR "canned tomatoes") (shortage OR prices OR supply)
